scripts.check: npm run check:abi && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:package && npm test && npm run check:generated --workspace @interest-protocol/blast-partner-client
scripts.format: biome format --write . && biome check --write --only=assist/source/organizeImports . && npm run format --workspace @interest-protocol/blast-partner-client
scripts.lint: npm run build && biome lint . && npm run lint --workspace @interest-protocol/blast-partner-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc && tsc -p e2e/presale-mainnet/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.ts && npm test --workspace @interest-protocol/blast-partner-client
scripts.check:package: npm run build && npm run check:package --workspaces && node scripts/check-workspace-packages.mjs
